However, he fell onto the couch thanks to his intoxication. Sidious claimed he had been manipulating him from the start, and he never intended to share the power. He was slowly killed by Sidious's tangle of Force lightning, eventually suffocating and losing his life, one that he believed he would never lose with his midi-chlorian studies. Darth Plagueis's body released an explosion of Dark Side energy that could be heard as a ripple throughout Coruscant, and knocked out Sidious. Plagueis's body did not dissolve, however, and was left behind.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Did you ever hear the Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise?|Palpatine to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
With the attention of the galaxy focused on the new Chancellor, the death of Hego Damask II went barely noticed by the galaxy at large&mdash;a galaxy from which he had completely removed himself in his last twenty years. A few hastily prepared obituaries mentioned only the scant information about his life that was available publicly. Members of the InterGalactic Banking Clan refused to release any information about Damask's funeral or about the disposition of his holdings.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Darth Sidious cremated his master`s body and kept his master's ashes in one of the two [[Spirit urn/Legends|spirit urns]] he kept at the entrance of his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends#Private Office (Private Use)|private office]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Beware the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]''</ref>

Though Plagueis purportedly taught Palpatine all he knew,<ref name="ROTS" /> and Palpatine himself had also participated in the earlier failed attempt at manipulating midi-chlorians that resulted in Anakin's birth,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Palpatine himself was unable to fully master Plagueis's teachings to cheat death through the Force via midi-chlorians, and was forced to rely on clone bodies to hold his spirit instead.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:Twin_spirit_urns.png|thumb|right|250px|The Sith spirit urns in Darth Sidious's collection, one of which contained Darth Plagueis's remains.]]
Sidious spoke little of Plagueis to his apprentice Darth Tyranus,<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> who himself knew the Muun as Hego Damask II.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Sidious used Plagueis's story to seduce Anakin Skywalker into becoming Vader. [[Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise/Legends|The Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise]], Chancellor Palpatine's Sith legend, told of Plagueis's abilities to create and preserve life; according to Palpatine, the tragic irony was that though he could keep others from dying, he could not save himself. Skywalker, seeking Plagueis's power to save his own wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]], later apprenticed himself to Sidious.<ref name="ROTS" /> In the following decades, Sidious only gave Vader brief hints about Plagueis.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

At some point after Palpatine brought the galaxy under his heel by reorganizing the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]], probably between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the Dark Lord included a manuscript fragment from Plagueis's scientific journal on the nature of the dark side and the progress of the Aborah experiments written by Plagueis's hand around 45 BBY (both dates were Master Luke Skywalker's non-scholarly estimates) into his ''[[Book of Sith]]'', showing respect for his master by including him among the handful of Sith who advanced the cause and left behind documents detailing their approach to the dark side. Sidious later archived the ''Book of Sith'' in his secret storehouse at [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="BookSith" />

At some point after Plagueis's death, some of the members of a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as the [[Apex Society]] believed that [[Collan Eislo]], the leader of the cult, was being guided by the spirits of deceased Sith Lords, such as Plagueis.<ref name="TUR">{{WizCite|story=The Mask of Darth Nihilus|book=The Unknown Regions}}</ref> Sidious eventually achieved "immortality" through cloning and the transfer of his soul, although he was ultimately defeated by Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>

[[File:Emperorreborn.jpg|thumb|left|Palpatine eventually achieved "immortality", unlike Plagueis.]]
When historians in later years were unable to find much information on Plagueis, they suspected that Sidious had destroyed everything about his master. The [[Wavlud Manuscript]], one of the few sources of knowledge for the Jedi on the Sith and Sidious, revealed information on Plagueis to the Galactic Alliance and [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="EGTTF" /> It is not known whether the information revealed about Plagueis identified him as the same individual as Hego Damask II. Another was his scientific journal included in the ''Book of Sith'', which was kept intact by Sidious and even jotted down his own personal notes on the subject. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the ''Book of Sith'' and Plagueis's journal were recovered from the Mount Tantiss storehouse and were passed to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the New Jedi Order Luke Skywalker. Skywalker proceeded to scribble his own notes onto it before passing it on to the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]].<ref name="BookSith" /> Even by [[36 ABY]], however, public knowledge of many details of Plagueis's life was still uncertain: the writers of a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|official history]] could chart only the broad strokes of his life, and were even uncertain as to the exact date of his murder by Sidious.<ref name="NEC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Billions of beings come into existence everyday, and billions more die. We should preserve only those who advance our goals or whose work is complementary to our own.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="BookSith" />}}
Darth Plagueis was considered a mystic,<ref name="NEC" /> despite the fact that he sought to develop an entirely rationalistic system of Force study, was among the few Sith Lords to have serious doubts about the existence of Force ghosts&mdash;even after confronting the purported ghost of Marka Ragnos&mdash;and was similarly weary of supposed prophecies.<ref name="BookSith" /> That said, he believed in the signs and portents.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Plagueis was a devotee of the dark side, and a lover of things otherworldly and arcane.<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> Obsessed with the prospect of eternal life<ref name="NEC" /> and ideas of spontaneous generation,<ref name="Vader">''[[Vader: The Ultimate Guide]]''</ref> he remained focused on matters of the material world,<ref name="UVG" /> though in later years Darth Vader mused that Plagueis had also desired a way to preserve the immaterial self after the death of the body.<ref name="DS" /> Although Plagueis, as a Sith Lord, rejected common morality and interpersonal ties as artificial restrictions fabricated by the weak to control the strong, he did develop a genuine bond with his apprentice, Darth Sidious, in an attempt to break the cycle of death started by Bane and thus further their own goals. Plagueis's effort was not reciprocated, however, and Sidious ultimately betrayed and murdered his Master in cold blood.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis was a vegetarian (though when direly hungry ate bats and even considered consuming people and took a bit out of a Kursid’s heart as a sign of dominance and savagery),<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and possessed a logical mind,<ref name="JAM">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/DarthPlagueis|text=''Jedi Academy'' Miniatures Preview 4}}</ref> and his apprentice Sidious believed that the extent to which he turned his sight inward was the source of his power and knowledge.<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> He also was able to think wisely and make sure to cover his tracks and also had a grim sense of humor.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> When he wrote his journals on the nature of the Force, he wrote them primarily in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although, in a chart he drew which demonstrated a triangular relationship between the aperion, anima, and pneuma, he curiously wrote his words backwards, with backwards [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters.<ref name="BookSith" /> He believed that power was to be gained incrementally, beginning with the self and culminating with control of the entire galaxy.<ref name="DL" /> As his own powers grew, he became afraid of nothing but losing that power.<ref name="ROTS" /> Plagueis was pathologically afraid of death, and this was the main reason he was chosen by Darth Tenebrous as an apprentice, Tenebrous would provide him immortality while Plagueis provided Tenebrous access to the Chosen One&mdash;or so Tenebrous thought&mdash;.<ref name="The Tenebrous Way" /> The Sith was willing to barter and bargain for passage with the ''Woebegone'' crew and honesty was confused by the idea of a ship having communal leadership. He told 11-4D that the droid agreeing with his plan of vigilance was a comfort. Though he executed Veruna for having turned against him and trying to nuke him, he respected the effort for trying to kill him and admired the man’s honesty when he said he would never have worked with Plagueis, had he known that Demask as really a Sith.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis argued that a Jedi could not properly touch the dark side and only Sith, always brought up in the dark and a greed for power, could belong to Bogan. Likewise he did not respect the Jedi Order since though they could rule the galaxy as tyrants and queens and impose a guiding order, demanding obedience as knowing best via the Force; yet they chose empathy and to merely guide, not dominate. Moreover he thought only a Sith Lord could guide the peoples of the galaxy, who he regarded as small-minded plebeians who needed the Sith Imperative to take care of them and show them their place. So he felt his role was not a crazed berserker as Sith of old were, but instead a guide for the galaxy. Likewise he was humble enough to accept the takes of scientists in fields of expertise he was not an expert in.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

He elected to change the usual means of Sith succession, death of the master by the hand of the apprentice,<ref name="EGTTF" /> by becoming immortal together with his own apprentice and forgoing the need for succession. Eventually, by his devoted and morally-unbound study, he achieved a level of midi-chlorian control that allowed him to kill and resurrect sentient beings, as well as regenerate damaged or aged portions of his body through direct mental contact with the organelles,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and came to see himself as the Sith'ari, the being free from all restrictions.<ref name="BookSith" /> Plagueis sometimes lied, but at the same time, he sometimes he told the truth from a certain point of view, such as when talking to a casino manager afraid that a rogue Force user was cheating by his powers, the Sith (as magister Damask) admitted that he too was interested the chemistry of Force potential. However, because of his arrogance<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and his weakened precognitive abilities resulting from his maxi-chlorian infection, as well as inability to realize he was being manipulated and deceived by Sidious, he never saw his own death coming.<ref name="The Tenebrous Way" /> He despised being near humans and their practices of eating meat and taking meals while doing business, but otherwise held a certain respect for them as highly evolved and intelligent creatures. As such, he thought that they, were on par with his people the Muuns, and should be deferred to and respected by the “lesser” species as he saw them. The way humans worked with these species and would take seemingly any job seemed silly to the Sith, while Muuns would only take a lowly job if it was for the greater good of all the kind. The Sith found the high gravity on Malastare oppressive and the Gran there even more insufferable. He also had a good relationship with the people of Kamino, hiring them as the clone masters who supplied Sojourn with the spawn of samples he gave them to resurrect dead species or propagating them as the hunting targets for his hunts. He claimed to never lie to Palpatine and argued that Jar Kai and Form Six and Taris Kasi were lesser than Dun Moch. Moreover he thought saberstaffs were a bit much, though he admitted that Darth Maul was an expert user of it.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis thought that the secrets of immortality were not meant for common beings, as he believed that if they all knew about them, civilization's structure would be destabilized. He especially did not want "common" beings to know the secrets as any "fool" could perpetuate their ignorance. Plagueis considered that life was not "mystical", like Tibanna gas or nova crystals, he believed life was a resource to be exploited, which is unique in that those who possess it to find it priceless, yet, he believed it is so common that it's functionally worthless. As billions of beings come into existence, and billions more die, Plagueis believed that the ones who advance his goals or whose work was complementary to his, were to be preserved.<ref name="BookSith" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|It's ironic. He could save others from death, but not himself.''"<br />"''Is it possible to learn this power?''"<br />"''Not from a Jedi.|Palpatine and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
[[File:PlagueisNSSGF.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Darth Plagueis wielding his lightsaber]]
Plagueis was very strong in the Force. He delved into the depths of the dark side and had awesome powers, capable of of hurling the dark side in battle, controlling and sensing others, healing the injured, and controlling life, among other things. Moreover, as of 52 BBY, Darth Sidious considered him to be a being of inspirational power far above his strength then. Being wounded and having parts of his body cut off did nothing to reduce his powers. Indeed if anything the attempt on his life drove him to learn how to forgo sleep and develop command over order/disorder and life/death, becoming like a nuclear blaze to Sidious’s Force sight.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Years after his death, his command over life and ability to hold back death were held as legendary to the Sith Order and the tales of his powers were used to turn Anakin Skywalker’s heart.<ref name="ROTS" />

With the Force, Plagueis was able to manipulate the essence of life,<ref name="Sith">{{DB|organization|thesith|Sith}}</ref><ref name="JAM" /> a power Palpatine believed was directly tied to his inward sight.<ref name="ROTSN" /> Plagueis could at a distance hold death at bay from his victims,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> [[Force healing/Legends|save others from death]] and, when his power was applied to the extreme, he could [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|create new life from the midi-chlorians found in all lifeforms]].<ref name="Vader" /> Early in his reign as Lord of the Sith, he could see the midi-chlorinan count of others and tell if they had enough to be Force-sensitive, though he could not touch these strange subjects of the Force to impose healing at this time. The Sith looked at Tenebrous with the Force, seeing the brain and heart of his lord dying as well as using his limited power in the organelles of the Force to see them dying out inside the Bith Sith, though back then he could not keep him alive had he wanted to. He never used this ability to study a Jedi, for fear that a knight of light would realize the Sith were at large. Through two years of research of midi-chlorian manipulation Plagueis was eventually able to bypass the defense an inherent near-immunity to [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] defenses of a Yinchorri to mentally manipulate him and he hoped to one day be able to use the command over the organs of the Force to mind-control anyone, even the leaders of planets. In this work he did experiments on many Hutts due to their resistance to mental tricks. Likewise, he plotted to be able to use the midi-chlorians to create life, even Force-sensitive life. He was able to make creatures become pregnant by his powers and by the time he used his power to do this, his magic and experiments had [[Taint|imbued]] his laboratory and the mountain it was in with the dark side. When early in his work he was using his powers to try to restore Venamis, he was shocked out of the event when Palpatine murdered his family with a force that seemed like the second most deep connection with the Force to date for him. Later in his work, he could do these arts to heal people. Another extreme example of this technique's applications is how it could be used to raise the dead back to life, as shown when it was used against Darth Venamis in 42 BBY to resurrect him many times. Sidious stated he killed and resurrected many people. He was able to use these powers cure his scars, breathe better than even before he was wounded, and stop them reverse aging. When Sidious shot his mask with lightning he simply gathered power and healed himself, too proud to die, though once he was being choked he could not heal himself. Over the course of eight years, he did make his midi-cloroian count grow, but he could not however create Force-sensitive life and his efforts to make such a thing killed a great number of his beasts which were afflicted by diseases. Another deadly side of this power was when he made Ars Veruna’s midi-clorians slowly fade out of him over the course of their conversation, a feat he admitted took a lifetime to develop and sparked a vision of his death.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> 

With normal [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing arts]] he held skill and found value, once rebuking Sidious for not bothering to learn about them (or mind-tricks) enough. Plagueis found that in his interest in murder he had not noticed his back getting wounded by a rock. So, he [[Control Pain|quenched his pain]] and made his body heal faster. On the ''Woebegone'', he temporarily healed two people while meditating and standing over them as they slipped into death, but he could not keep them alive, much to his chagrin. He found that in general repairing blood vessels, bones, muscles, and organs was not harder than lifting rocks with the Force and that healing someone else was easier than self-repair. As an incentive for his student, he offered to heal Sidious after depriving him for weeks and forcing him to climb to him. In the years after claiming the mantle of the Sith Master, he also studied healing in his prisoners, using the midi-chlorians of his prisoners and captured beasts to make them self-repair. While fighting his assassins, Plagueis was able motionlessly self-diagnoses his wounds and blood loss then chose to use a Sith [[heart stun]]ning technique to alter chemistry inside and keep two of his three hearts from failing. By 42 BBY, was able to make others come back from death (unless their organs were too worn out), a power he learned the same day after he and Palpatine claimed a sense of control over the Force. From this he turned the technique on himself, slowly starting to fix his mutilations over the course of months of study and years of effort.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Plagueis also discovered the ability to [[Force ghost/Legends|retain one's identity in the Force while becoming one with it]], but this manner of surviving death did not appeal to him, as he was not concerned with the non-material world.<ref name="UVG" /> Indeed he thought the power was rather rubbish, since he thought that no Sith Lords could or did guide the order which proved to his mind that Sith ghosts were weak.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis was also skilled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and although he disdained using his blade in combat—regarding lightsaber duels as tedious affairs—Tenebrous viewed his apprentice as a master of the art. Though starving, Plagueis easily, if a bit clumsily (by his standards), carved through the ''Wobegone’s'' crew when no deal came about, nearly beheading the captain and her ally, then hacking his way to the rest of the crew, before butchering the rest with his blade and dark powers, parrying or returning barrages and crossfires of bolts. Plagueis also was an agile combatant and could fight off attackers without recourse to his weapon. He was able to fight so fast during his duel with Venamis that an onlooker would have thought him a thunderbolt racing through the trees, though he took light wounds in the contest. Eventually after taking a light wound, [[Battlemind|using the Force to fight better]] he sent his mind out of his body and used his flesh like a puppet, defending as needed but not attacking until throwing himself back into himself to fight, slashing the other man across the body then disarming him. On Mygeeto he lashed Palpatine with his saber, leaving the man with many burns to make him learn how to cope with pain and on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] he and his student stood side by side with their sabers (for defense and deflection only) against two hundred training droids. He also carefully opened a Kursid warrior’s chest and ripped out his heart for the fear factor.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis was a master of augmenting his body with the Force. Examples being how, to get inside [[Darth Tenebrous's personal starship]] the Muun [[Force punch]]ed its jammed door open, on the ''Woebegone'' he Force punched a Zabrak so hard his spine broke. He punched through the chests of Maladians and [[Enhance Attribute|made himself strong, to able to snap their necks in his hands]], using these powers frequently, before and after a heart failed when he beat skulls apart with blows. The Dark Lord cloaked in the name Demask showed power in [[Force deflection/Legends|deflecting shots off his hands]] and [[Tutaminis|absorbing]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and then channeling it into Force lightning, an ability that he was also very skilled in, and showed in that struggle that he could also [[Soft to Solid|make his body too tough for blunt attacks to harm him]]. Though trained in the skill to [[Force jump/Legends|augment his jumps with the Force]], he admitted to himself that he could not use the Force to fly or leap out of the grotto he slew his mentor in from ground level, instead using telekinesis to shift slabs of rock to make a crude pile, such that after climbing it he could Force jump to freedom. Decades later, he effortlessly leap atop a ten meter high wall guarding the Veruna castle without breaking stride and dropped down into the garden. He could make himself [[Theran Force-listening|able to hear better]], a power he reprised when he invaded Veruna’s home. The Sith was a prolific user of [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]], running alongside his mentor to escape a collapsing tunnel and then chaining it into his runs for two nights, using bursts of this power to travel to a spaceport. While running with the dark side's speed, he sometimes looked like little more than a blur, though the strain of this Force-empowered marathon and his wounds left him exhausted and hungry. The Sith Lord used the dark again to move as a blur to storm into the ship he stole’s crew room. He was able to run so fast during his duel with Venamis that an onlooker would have thought him a thunderbolt racing through the trees, after already having run out rashly to find whoever was breaking in. He again used the Force to move with swiftness against the Maladians. When he went to seal Ars Veruna’s fate, he ran as fast as a Naboo four-legged creature, fast enough to trick scanners. Plagueis could use [[Force stealth]], developing the skill on his own as a young Muun to keep his powers secret from any save his parents and using it to hide from his enemies such as Venamis on Sojourn and twice to avoid the Jedi on Abraxin. Likewise, he buried his presense on Serenno and Coruscant, so well that firstly Qui-Gon, Nu; both times Dooku, Sifo-Dyas; and latter his own student could not sense his powers, though the latter time Dooku got an idea that there was something a bit strange about the Sith, but no more. Through his life, he attended parties and events with Jedi, but was not found out. The first time he looked closely at Maul, he watched while his Force presence was buried. At times his eyes glowed, as when he attacked the ''Wobegone''; and he called himself a “yellow-eyed monster” once to Sidious. When preaching the outline of the Clone Wars and the Empire to Sidious on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], his eyes once more shone. His orbs turned yellow again when he was told how foolish and wild the Trade Federation underlings were acting. During his fight with Venamis, his sudden counterattack was so fueled by rage that his saber blazed with a brief, eye-hurting, light. Plagueis sometimes [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] to pass the time. He apparently was also capable of [[Convection]] and/or [[Pyrokinesis]] as he was able to melt snowflakes before they reached his person on Mygeeto, and could use the dark to [[Tapas|keep himself able walk through]] that world’s blizzards without protective clothing at the age of eight. On his run after becoming the only true Sith Lord to fight the attention of bugs, he lowered his body temperature and altered the gasses his breath exhaled, but to no real effect so he gave up. His [[Force bellow]] was as powerful as any sonic weapon, breaking the ears of Maladians within ten meters and making the rest cover their ears. In the Veruna estate, he twice made a [[Force-flash|camera malfunction and get flashed into giving a false image of a clear room]]. The Sith also could [[Technometry|command doors to open]] for him and make security alarms fail.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Darth Plagueis was an expert in [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. On Bal'demnic working with and [[Force channeling|aided]] by his master, the Muun raised a [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]] to keep back an explosion and then reached out with both his arms and Force yanked down a rain of stone to mortally wound his master, nearly burying the Bith and putting a spike of rock through his lung. To get out of the cave he had usurped power in, he shifted slabs of stone to give himself a platform to Force jump out of the grotto that the Sith Order had just lost half its members inside. When he pirated the ''Woebegone'', he killed an enemy and literally disarmed another with a saber throw, then took the last wounded crewman’s life with a telekinetic impulse invoked by a snap of his fingers. During his duel with his master’s other student he pulled his weapon to his hand (at the end of the duel pulling the same trick an instant faster than his foe to steal his saber), then cut a tree branch with a Force blow. The first time that he saw Palpatine overtly use the Force he remained unphased through a buffet of the Force. Likewise, while training his human to try to catch him as a show of skill he pushed Sidious over when the human lunged at him, then Force pulled him to his feet without lifting a finger, much like how eleven years later, he knocked a Kursid warrior over for a ritual slaughter. On Sojourn, the Muun Force choked Sidious as a demonstration of the strength of the dark side and as flexing of his power. This was much as Plagueis had closed the neck of, then broken Kerred Santhe’s trachea in the Sith’s mission for his master. When killers came for him on Coruscant at the Lodge of the Canted Circle, he Force clamped his neck and where his jaw had been cut off and barely kept himself awake through the pain, then rose to his feet with the lifting force of his mind and pushed close killers with the dark before fighting with Force-powered melee and he was able to turn any object into a deadly projectile with just a clap of his hands to be flung at the assassins.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> After two of his hearts were down, he still made a Force shield to keep off the assassins' daggers then soon conjured up a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Wave]] so powerful, that he was able to atomize six of his assailants, and bring it around to kill a six more; though he was unable to keep up his wall of will and was cut more. He tried to pull a gun to himself, but one of the Maladian threw his own body to tackle down the incoming blaster. Lying on the ground, he shook the floor with his mind, staggering some of his foes. The Sith was able to be very precise as well, using the Force to push a plane of glass out of a window and floated it harmlessly onto a table. He also made Veruna choke a bit to stop being hysterical.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

As Sith were wont to do, Plagueis often employed [[Force lightning/Legends|Sith lightning]] to fight and destroy. During his last meeting with his master, he worked with the other Lord to shoot blue lightning bolts down a shaft to try to destroy a rogue probe droid driller that had been programed to dig in such a way as to blow him and Tenebrous. He channeled a blaster bolt that hit his hand into more blue death, blasting a man to death on the ''Wobegone''. To remove a [[Unidentified Iktotchi prophet|prophetess]], he grabbed her hands and subtly ran Force lightning into her body until her bodily fluids fairly boiled and she died. Teaching on Buoyant, he flung a barrage of lightning that ignited the grass around him. When the Maladians came for him, due to his wounds, one of his hearts gave out when he tried to use lightning to defend himself. In his final moments, he evoked a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] over himself, but the minor weather phenomenon was useless beyond scattering objects.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis had a range of powers relating to the mind. The Sith was able to [[Mind trick/Legends|affect the minds of others]], even as an untrained child, mind-tricking a fellow youngling to jump out a window. While skilled, a limitation he came up against was the natural Yinchorri resistance to mental trickery. He was able to find a way to trick the minds of that species after two years of trying on an enslaved prisoner and did similar things to other captives. When he met an Iktotchi prophet and killed her with lightning, he used mind tricks to make her followers “help her” and agree that he totally had not attacked her. He also mind-tricked one of Padme’s handmaidens to tell him where Anakin was. Similarly, as a youngling he had a limited mental empathy which he used to trick and harass his playmates. He was skilled in conjuring [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|Force illusions]], making and speaking through a [[Dopplegänger|doppleganger]] a few feet away convincing enough to fool Sidious (albeit at the start of Palpatine’s Sith training). In concert with his apprentice in Sidious’s 23th Sith year, they meditated for months, then both Sith projected their spirits out as one joined entity rising into the Force to alter it towards darkness and claiming sovereignty over the Force, a feeling like overthrowing a god.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

He has a potent [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]]. On Bal'demnic, Plagueis was able to sense his teacher thinking that he was figuring out that he had killed him and was able to shrug off a [[Mind Shard|slash of mental rage]]. A few nights later, he was disquieted by being able to sense someone of about equal power but not who or where, he opened himself to the Force when looking at the hologram of the woman whose ship he would hijack and the next day. Shortly after taking control of the Sith, he suddenly felt the dark side’s grandeur as like a great storm and heard the voices of the Banate Sith Order for a moment. On Sojourn, he mentally scanned his vicinity after a security breach, soon being drawn to face Venamis, who he soon discovered was a Force user but not that he was a darksider until he faced him face to face. In his last meeting with Palpatine before the young man murdered his family, he casually sensed that a woman in the same courtyard was Vidar Kim‘s paramour. He was about to make a final attack when the Maladians almost killed him, but stopped when he felt Sidious and Pestage were there to help him. In the duel with Venamis, he [[Sense Force|sensed]] a build-up of lightning, responding thus in time to capture the other Sith. Likewise he saw how strong Sidious was getting over the years, impressing the Dark Lord. At Colliders Casino, he sensed a [[Unidentified Shi'ido|cheating Shi'ido]] and [[Technometry|how he was using the Force]], but the other Force user noticed his second and deeper look; the Sith also used his Force sense to know when his quarry had shapechanged. Later, again he sensed that the planet Abraxin was no longer a loadstone of dark side power and used his powers and ears to tell when the Jedi hunting Lare were coming at him. Before training as a Sith, he had developed this capability of seeing when others used the Force. Plagueis could [[Sense Force Potential|sense if others could use the Force]], coming to be aware that the Jedi his father met with were able to use powers like he could but in a nature different to him and also sensing that Tenebrous could use powers like him. Once Sidious took ownership of murdering his family, Plagueis sensed his strength growing. He tried and failed to feel why his master was so agitated when the Cortosis mine was about to blow up. When he first met Palpatine, he drew himself deeply into the Force and tried twice to [[Force empathy/Legends|empathetic read]] what the young man but failed to glean much from the young Force user’s cloudy mind, realizing the next day that he was stymied by Palpatine’s psychic walls. He also knew that Sidious felt a bit of conflict about being told to kill his closest friend, Vidar Kim, though Palpatine, of course, carried out the murder without speaking up. Plagueis was able to reach into Jabba the Hutt with his power and [[Truth-sense|know Jabba was not lying]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

The dark side spoke to the Muun, telling him when to kill Tenebrous. Although Plagueis briefly lost long-term [[Force vision/Legends|foresight]] after Tenebrous died at his hands, that power seemed to reappear a day after Tenebrous' murder, as demonstrated when he had received a vision of the Battle of Bal'demnic. Another spark of understanding came at the time when Palpatine slew his kindred and Plagueis got a sudden deluge of understanding of past, present, and future. He did, however, follow the signs and portents that showed, he thought, that the Republic and Jedi were vulnerable to the Sith plans. An example was how he interpreted the nuclear obliteration of his sanctum on Sojourn as the Force guiding and balancing the scales, a blow against him in return for his gains over the Trade Federation. Similarly to when his master’s death was announced by the dark, on Dooku’s homeworld the Sith was suddenly found himself choking up, the dark side protecting him from saying too much by making him unable to speak when he almost talked about Kaminio in front of Dooku, Sifo-Dyas, Jinn, and Nu. As he killed Veruna, he got a strange sense he had done this already, in truth a premonition of how Sidious would betray and kill him in almost the same way. He also knew before it happened that Master Sifo-Dyas was going to agree to make the Clone Army. When observing Maul receiving his marching orders to go to Jabba’s domain, he decided to risk a look into fate and foresaw that Maul and Sidious might never meet again and that the aggressive Sith plots might reveal them. Later, days before his own death, he glimpsed events surrounding Darth Maul and Anakin Skywalker, foreseeing the Clone Wars and Skywalker’s role in the war, and the armoring of Darth Vader. As such, he understood before the Battle of Theed that Anakin would live and the Trade Federation armies would lose. Moreover, his short-term [[Precognition/Legends|precognitive abilities]] remained functional, as when he knew that he was fated to fight the ''Wobegone’s'' crew. When he was attacked at a Canted Circle meeting, he sensed there was going to be a fight, but hesitated, attempting to keep hidden as much as possible and nearly died from that.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> 

On Abraxin, Plagueis twice flared his dark side presence, once to see if a Jedi would notice him, again pretending in mind-nature to be a Marsh Haunt to call Naat Lare as the Muun lurked in a mud pit. When converting Palpatine to joining the Sith, he allowed the young man to sense a bit of his might. Similarly, when he fought for his life in the lodge of the Canted Circle, the amount of dark side power he unleashed was clear to Sidious as soon as the human opened himself to the Force and tainting the ground he fought upon with the dark side. Though badly hurt by the Maladian murderers at the Canted Circle lodge, he was able to get rid of them all, some disposed of with his powers with the help of Sidious holding them off. He might have pushed Palpatine with a burst of air early in the human's training. Yet, he could not call [[Alter Environment|air flows or rain and lightning storms]], become invisible, fly, or [[fold space]], though he had tried to learn these powers based on legends of old.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Additionally, he was aware of some of the more obscure techniques of the Jedi Order, such as [[Electric Judgment|Emerald Lightning]] and [[Sever Force/Legends|Sever Force]], though he was not known to use these powers himself.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /><ref name="BookSith" />

Beyond his Force powers, he was a very capable combatant, breaking his master’s neck with a single heavy hand strike and fighting an army of almost thousand Kursid with just a Force pike and Palpatine as his ally, not taking a scratch or having to kill any other than one who was ritually slaughtered. He could speak Muun, Basic, Barabel, and Klatooinian. Plagueis knew a huge range of weapons and what their uses were, a trait he passed to Sidious. He was tough enough to get to his feet for a moment after Sidious shot his breath mask and then went all out blasting him with lightning. Palpatine also stated that he had clouded the Muun’s mind. The Sith was a skilled [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and ran many tests on himself and others, such as checking and seeing that his midi count did not automatically grow even when he became more powerful. The Sith also invented the mask he wore in response to his wounds. He also was a canny manipulator of others, working designs to collapse the Republic via corruption, greed, and stirring people against the light; likewise he read the young Palpatine’s personality and was skilled at the management of his business and the other responsibilities of the life he lead apart from his role as a Sith. On Buoyant he hunted with his student, lancing animals and on Hypori he argued all weapons must be understood. He was a good researcher and had a better sense of direction than his master, though a poor sense of smell. He was a gifted slicer and sneak.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /><ref name="Lockdown" /> He was able to infiltrate Ars Veruna’s castle and kill him, though even his resources had limits: Plagueis couldn’t get the base’s floor plans and had to go in blind.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

He was able to read maps.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Equipment==
Darth Plagueis used a red-bladed lightsaber that was crafted sometime in his years as an apprentice under his master, [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. After Plagueis murdered his master on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] continued to be in his possession, even at the time he trained [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as his apprentice. When his own apprentice Palpatine [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|executed]] [[Pax Teem]] as retribution for outwitting (and nearly killing) him and his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], Sidious used Plagueis's lightsaber. He noted that it had been built for a larger grip and had to use two hands to effectively wield it. Wealthy, he had a whole library and lab filled with his dark experiments and knowledge, a water breather for his mouth, and countless other assets and fiscal resources. He also had self-invented [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator mask]] from 52 BBY to 32 BBY, owing to his wounds, worn until the time of his death.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In some respects, Plagueis is a different breed of Sith, he's passionate and arrogant, but loyal to the Sith imperative to topple the Republic and eradicate the Jedi Order. But he is not infallible, and his sense of commitment could be interpreted as a fatal flaw.|[[James Luceno]]|<ref name="Insider 130">[[Star Wars Insider 130|''Star Wars Insider'' 130]]</ref>}}
[[File:Plagueis.jpg|thumb|left|A non-canonical image of Darth Plagueis from ''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]'']]
Darth Plagueis was named as early as the first draft of the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] ([[April]] [[2003]]) and possibly earlier.<ref name="ROTS Making of">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> His name is clearly derived from the English word "plague," a connection later made in-universe in the [[Wizards of the Coast]] article "[[Behind the Threat: The Sith]], Part 2: The Becoming".<ref name="TB">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/BtT2|series=Behind the Threat: The Sith|text=Part 2: The Becoming}}</ref> Plagueis's first appearance of any sort was in the non-[[canon]] ''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]''. This comic stated that Plagueis's manipulation of the midi-chlorians produced Force-sensitivity in [[Tag Greenly]] and [[Bink Otauna/Legends|Bink Otauna]] who would later become heroes. This also marked the only appearance of [[Darth Plagueis's staff]] in any [[Star Wars]] story.<ref name="T&B">''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]''</ref>

===The Darth Plagueis novel===
On [[June 8]], [[2006]], [[StarWars.com]] announced that [[James Luceno]] was scheduled to write a novel about Darth Plagueis that would be released in [[2008]]. The book's announcement was the first source to identify Plagueis as a Muun.<ref name="Luceno">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/news20060608.html|text=Luceno to Pen Plagueis Page-turner}}</ref> However, on [[March 27]], [[2007]], [[Sue Rostoni]] announced that the novel had been removed from the publishing schedule. Rostoni's explanation for the cancellation was that "this was not the right time to delve into Palpatine's backstory and Plagueis's beginnings."<ref name="Sue Rostoni">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|9|Ballantine/Del Rey Fiction Schedule}}</ref> The novel was replaced with ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''.<ref name="TOS 1">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=04980#16712103|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni|Eeusu Estornii]]|date=2007-06-18|time=9:57 AM}}</ref> Though Plagueis's species had been revealed in the novel's announcement, [[Leland Chee]] stated that its cancellation did not affect that decision, as it had not originated in the novel.<ref name="Leland Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1290#16446203|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-03-30|time=11:52 AM|quote=That info did not originate from the novel, so yes, we still consider it canon.}}</ref> A panel on continuity at the [[Celebration IV]] convention revealed that his identity as a Muun had originally come from [[George Lucas]].<ref name="cp">[[Forum:CIV Continuity Questions|Celebration IV continuity Q&A]]</ref> [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] confirmed his species as a Muun and was the first source to give him a canonical image. On [[July 27]], [[2010]], information from a sales database leaked indicating that the novel was once more on the publishing schedule. Sue Rostoni subsequently confirmed the announcement.<ref name="TOS 2">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17921027|thread=Darth Plagueis Novel by James Luceno *Speculation*|user=[[Sue Rostoni|Eeusu Estornii]]|date=2010-07-27|time=12:01 PM|nobackup=1}}</ref> The novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagieis'']] was finally released on [[January 10]], [[2012]] in hardcover, e-book, and audiobook format.<ref name="SWBooks">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=starwarsbooks/posts/10150350678103713|name=Star Wars Books|date=2011-09-30|archivedate=20160115204708}}</ref>

===Contradictions===
''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' implied that Palpatine killed Plagueis out of the suspicion that Plagueis was secretly crafting a new apprentice to take over when doing the Grand Experiment.<ref name="NEC" /> However, this was revealed to be incorrect in ''Darth Plagueis''.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> In the [[2011]] short story "[[The Tenebrous Way]]," an illustration by [[Brian Rood]] depicts Plagueis with a large, human-like nose,<ref name="The Tenebrous Way" /> in keeping with the Muun characters shown in both ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''<ref name="CWC9">{{CW|9}}</ref> and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="PoP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> However, this contradicts the depiction of the Muuns with noses that were nearly flush with the rest of their faces in most other sources, including their appearance in films like [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="AOC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="ROTS" />

There also exist contradictions in the birthyear of Darth Plagueis. According to ''Darth Plagueis'', Damask told Palpatine, in 65 BBY, that he would be "well over one hundred" in human years, suggesting a birthdate of c. [[170 BBY/Legends|170 BBY]] or earlier. However, this is contradicted by "The Tenebrous Way", which states that, after killing [[Darth Tenebrous's Sith Master|his master]], Darth Tenebrous embarked on a "decades-spanning quest" for a new apprentice. Considering that, according to ''Darth Plagueis'', Tenebrous killed his master c. [[167 BBY]] and arranged for Plagueis's birth, the earliest date for Plagueis's birth would have to be c. [[147 BBY/Legends|147 BBY]]. Elsewhere in ''Darth Plagueis'', Damask mentions that he undertook his first mission as a Sith, the assassination of Kerred Santhe the Elder, approximately twenty-five years into his apprenticeship. Per ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', this cannot be earlier than [[99 BBY/Legends|99 BBY]], suggesting a birthdate of c. [[130 BBY]].

===Cut content===
Darth Plagueis was originally intended to appear in the [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] version of the non-canonical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', but was removed from the game. His name, however, was listed in the game's text files.<ref name="Wii files">{{WebCite|url=https://tcrf.net/LEGO_Star_Wars:_The_Complete_Saga_(Wii)|text=Unused Features of ''LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga''|work=[http://tcrf.net The Cutting Room Floor]|archivedate=20121004070420}}</ref>

Plagueis' death at Palpatine's hands was originally going to be shown in the Darth Maul-themed video game code-named ''[[Battle of the Sith Lords]]'', which would have happened earlier in the game to start Maul's training with Palpatine. In [[April]] [[2020]], [[Dan Borth]], the former head of Red Flyer was interviewed by the YouTube channel "Bombastic" where he discussed the projects development and cancellation and revealed unseen footage and story details including the depiction of Darth Plagueis' death and the rise of Palpatine, with the game's structure consisting on Maul's origins, his apprenticeship with Palpatine, tie-ins with the Clone Wars, and Maul meeting [[Darth Talon]] in the [[Legacy era]].<ref name="Bombastic Dan Borth ITW">{{YouTube|video=cUrTtF0edCg|text=The cancelled Star Wars Origin Story we'll never know|channel=channel/UCSPZGQNwMhWbLfaHL6VVLwQ|name=Bombastic}}</ref>

[[File:Plagueis_concepts.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Plagueis concepts for ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'']]
When creating the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' multimedia project]], the development team looked to a number of unexplored characters and events for inspiration, amongst them Plagueis. The initial plan was to use Plagueis as a Sith spirit who would give the player of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'' game]] new dark-side powers and information. Another idea involved the [[Galen Marek|Secret Apprentice]], the main character, sent to find Plagueis as part of a plot by Darth Vader to resurrect [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Still other ideas included revealing that the Apprentice was Plagueis reborn, or using a reformed Plagueis as the Apprentice's mentor. As the team did not know much about Plagueis at first, they started with human designs, including famous actor [[Wikipedia:Michael Gambon|Michael Gambon]]. Concept artist [[Greg Knight]] explored a number of directions, including the undead, a character from a different time, someone using machines to stay alive, eerie youthfulness, the occult, and a number of "freaky and exotic" ideas.<ref name="Art of TFU">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
